operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Adds a single **component (raw-material) line** to an existing bundle product by creating one product-bundle record.

- `product_id` — the component product to add to the bundle.
- `bundle_product_id` — the existing bundle product the component is attached to.
- `quantity` — how many units of the component the bundle consumes.

Both `product_id` and `bundle_product_id` are required and must reference existing products.

> To build a whole bundle product **and** its lines in one request, create the product entity instead and send the lines as a nested `product_bundles` array; this endpoint adds one line at a time.

product_id.description: Required. The component (raw-material) product to add to the bundle.

bundle_product_id.description: Required. The existing bundle product the component is attached to.

quantity.description: Quantity of the component consumed per bundle unit. Strongly recommended; defaults to `0` when omitted.

unit_name.description: Optional. Display name of the selected unit.

unit_factor.description: Optional. Conversion factor of the selected unit relative to the base unit.

unit_small_name.description: Optional. Display name of the base (small) unit.

unit_factor_id.description: Optional. Identifier of the selected unit factor.

200.description: The component was added to the bundle.

id.description: The id of the newly created product-bundle record.

400.description: The record could not be saved — typically a required field (product_id or bundle_product_id) is missing or invalid.

e.description: Diagnostic details about the failure. May be an empty array when no structured detail is available.

error.description: Human-readable description of why the save failed.
